'''Manteeny''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Stalkerix]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Manteeny seems convinced that waving those little pink scythes around is some kind of elegant etiquette, and there's been more than a few accidental nicks around camp."

Manteeny is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, light pink, and white orchid mantis with cyan eyes and light green accents on its front legs.

Manteeny's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces light pink with sky magenta, and green becomes aquamarine.

== Evolution Requirements ==
Manteeny's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Stalkerix]] you need to complete the following task:
* Use Manteeny to clear 20 [[battle|stages]].

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "Critter researchers think that the key step in Manteeny's evolution is making it eat certain things."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Male and female Manteenies do not differ much in body size, so it's hard to tell them apart at this point."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "With movement as graceful as a dancer, Manteeny mimics a flower among blooms to strike unsuspecting prey."
